matches.rationale: Pred 2 targets Theorem 5.1 directly, showing that its stated hypothesis ($H^1_{fl}=0$) is inconsistent with the duplicate statement in §1.3 and with the four uses of $H^2$ inside the proof, and explains how this degenerates/invalidates the argument — the same logical flaw in Theorem 5.1 recorded by the ground truth. Pred 3, though located in §5, reports a factor interchange it itself deems harmless ('nullified') and which recurs identically in the appendix, so it does not describe the proof-invalidating flaw.

pred_verdicts.rationale: Points at a cohomological-bound exponent in Lemma 2.12, an apparent pre-existing misprint unrelated to the listed ground-truth defect in Theorem 5.1.
Credited in Part 1 as identifying the logical defect in Theorem 5.1.

Asserts a reversal of $E_1$/$E_2$ factors in (11) that the paper writes the same way again in the appendix, and admits it is inconsequential, suggesting a derivation/convention misreading rather than a real defect.
